verdict.rationale: Pika documents a first-party 'Camera Director' app that lets a creator reshoot an uploaded clip from a different angle or viewpoint. That is real camera-direction control rather than accepting the model's default framing. However, the evidence only covers changing viewpoint on an existing clip and never documents choosing specific camera moves during generation. Missing for 10: explicit pan, zoom, orbit and static camera-move controls; camera control in text- or image-to-video generation; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can direct camera moves (pan, zoom, orbit, static) instead of accepting whatever motion the model picks

citations.quote: Camera Director: Reshoot a clip from any angle
